reasons.issue: Scenario briefing carries two YOU subject-verb agreement errors ("Navy YOU defends the right net", "YOU starts inside F1's route") AND a wrong attack-direction word ("Gold attacks -x") that contradicts F1/F2's facing (0 rad, toward +x), the home/Navy goalie's position at x=+26, and the scene's own cues text ("Gold F1 carries toward the right net"). All render on every linked question.
reasons.change: Corrected briefing to "Gold attacks +x. Navy YOU defend the right net; F1 carries toward the net with F2 wide. YOU start inside F1's route, with the goalie behind." No actor, coordinate, or answer key changed -- the right-net answer was already correct because it is anchored to the actually-drawn goalie, not to the briefing's direction word.
reasons.evidence: Geometry/attack-direction check: the briefing states "Gold attacks -x," but F1 (Gold's carrier) and F2 both face 0 rad (toward +x), the home/Navy goalie sits at x=+26 (the net F1 is facing), and the scenario's own cues list already says "Gold F1 carries toward the right net" (+x side). Cross-checked against the bank's own established convention (verified in sibling scenario exp26-u11-012, which explicitly pairs "Navy attacks the right net (+x)" with "gold attacks the left net", i.e. a team's stated attack direction names the NET IT IS ATTACKING, which belongs to the opponent) and against exp26b-u11-014 (Navy attacks +x -> the +x goalie is the away/Gold team's own goalie, confirming the pattern): if Gold truly attacked -x, Gold's target net (Navy's own net) would need to sit at x=-26 with a home/Navy goalie there, not at x=+26. All four independent facts (F1 facing, F2 facing, the home goalie's side, and the scene's own cues text) agree with "Gold attacks +x" and disagree with the briefing's stated "-x" -- the briefing's direction word is the outlier, not the geometry. Base scenario hash b41d8da8823117c456f9c3d7bc886c47c944dd5636dfca9f9eac823eacc17441 -> replacement scenario hash a96b3108b4b082ec32537d52e61e98fdba9aaf9f7c91b6a435015cfa67097392.

reasons.issue: RETRACTED-AND-CORRECTED finding: my initial repair (before the coordinator's messages) concluded '"Gold attacks -x" was the error and the goalie's x=+26 was correct,' based on F1/F2's facing (0 rad, toward +x) and the scene's own cues text. A repo-wide scan (by a parallel agent, cross-checked against the app's own hardcoded 'NAVY ATTACKS →' board label and AUTHORING-CONTRACT.md's permanent Navy=+x/Gold=-x convention) found this exact pattern -- 'Gold attacks -x' scenes with a home goalie drawn at x=+26 instead of x=-26 -- in exactly 4 scenes bank-wide (-015/-016/-017/-018), while 5/5 correctly-oriented scenes checked put the mirror-image goalie correctly. A second, independent agent proposed the opposite fix (relabel the goalie 'away' instead of moving it). See full reasoning below.
reasons.change: Adopted Theory 1 for -015 (goalie team label "home" is correct; its position was wrong): moved the goalie from (26,0) facing 3.1 to (-26,0) facing ~0.0416 (pi - 3.1, mirroring the actor about the y-axis). Reverted the briefing/cues/q1 direction wording from my earlier (now-superseded) '+x'/'right net' phrasing back to the original 'Gold attacks -x' framing (which was correct all along), but corrected 'right net' -> 'left net' throughout (briefing, cues, q1 answer, q2 option b, q4 prompt) since Navy's own net is now correctly on the left. Also softened the briefing/cues claim that "YOU starts inside F1's route" (now computed false -- see q4) to "YOU start this read behind F1's route and must close the inside space."
reasons.evidence: SECOND FINDING (repo-wide, raised by the coordinator after two parallel agents found the same underlying inconsistency but proposed opposite fixes): Theory 1 (from the -016/-017 agent): this goalie IS Navy's own goalie (team label "home" correct), but its POSITION (x=26) is wrong -- AUTHORING-CONTRACT.md fixes Navy/home to always attack +x, so Navy's own net/goalie must always sit at -x; should move to x=-26. Theory 2 (from the -018 agent): this goalie IS Gold's own goalie (the net Navy is attacking), so its POSITION (x=26) is correct but its TEAM label is wrong -- should be "away", matching the dozens of bank-wide scenes where this exact (x=26, facing=3.1) template pairs with team="away". DECISION FOR -015: Theory 1. This scenario's own base-version text settles it unambiguously: the briefing explicitly states "Navy YOU defends the right net" (naming the net where the goalie already sits as the net NAVY defends, not attacks) and describes "the goalie behind" YOU -- a defensive framing (a team's own goalie stands behind its own defender, guarding that defender's own net). There is no offensive/shooting content anywhere in this scenario (YOU never carries or shoots the puck; F1/Gold does) that would support Theory 2's "the goalie you're facing" reading. So the team label (home/Navy) is correct and the position (x=26) is what's wrong; corrected to x=-26 with facing mirrored to ~0.0416 rad (pi - 3.1, reflecting the actor about the y-axis consistent with negating x). This resolves the SEPARATE, earlier (now-retracted) finding in this repair's first reasons entry below, which had concluded the opposite (that "Gold attacks -x" was the error and the goalie's x=+26 was correct) based on F1/F2's facing and the scene's own cues text -- that conclusion is superseded by the coordinator's repo-wide, app-hardcoded-convention evidence, which is authoritative over in-bank pattern-matching. OPEN CONCERN carried forward for Codex/whoever reviews -019: F1 and F2 still face 0 rad (toward +x), i.e. AWAY from the now-corrected net at x=-26, and YOU's own start position (x=15) is not, by computed betweenness, positioned between F1 (x=9) and the corrected net (x=-26) -- YOU is on the far side of F1 from the net, not inside it. This means the ENTIRE actor layout (YOU/F1/F2 positions and F1/F2 facing), not just the goalie, appears to have been authored assuming the net sat at +26. Fixing only the goalie restores the correct 'which net' answer but leaves the scenario's 'YOU starts inside F1's route' premise geometrically false and q4's position reference no longer between the carrier and the net (see q4 below). A fully coherent fix likely requires repositioning YOU/F1/F2 too, which is a larger, scenario-redesign-level change outside what was authorized for this pass -- flagged for a scope decision rather than guessed at.
